name: Comic Con India (Chennai)
blurb: Chennai leg of Comic Con India's national pop-culture tour, run with ReedPop, with comics-industry and pop-culture guests.
notes: Re-checked comicconindia.com fresh (--fresh); the live homepage city slider still only shows Visakhapatnam, Navi Mumbai, Delhi, Hyderabad and Jalandhar, and the former city page (comicconindia.com/all-cities-main-page/chennai-comic-con, indexed by Google) now 404s, confirming no 2026-27 Chennai edition has been announced yet. Added 'last': Deccan Chronicle reports 'Chennai is set to host the 2026 edition of Comic Con India on February 14 and 15 at the Chennai Trade Centre, organisers announced' - this edition already happened before the research window (2026-10-05) opened.
